classes.name: ScreenAuthorizationSubscriber
classes.description: A Symfony event subscriber that manages access control for screens based on user permissions, handling kernel controller and exception events to enforce authorization rules.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Registers event listeners for controller and exception kernel events.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Handles controller events to check user permissions and capabilities before allowing access to the requested screen.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Intercepts ForbiddenException and redirects to a Forbidden page response.

methods.name: getControllerInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the controller instance from the controller event.
